model.note: Picking a path is optional and skippable. Every level and lesson is visible and doable by anyone regardless of path. A path is a recommended track plus a progress overlay and capstone - never a gate or lock.

placementQuiz.effect: suggests a path only; never restricts access

prerequisiteFixes: business-product and legal-risk include a RAG primer (8.1/8.2) so Level 11's 'Agent + RAG' content is not reached cold.
business-product includes evaluation basics (6.1/6.2/6.4) since the focus claims evaluation and Level 10.6 (Agent Evaluation) depends on it.
legal-risk includes 8.2 alongside 8.4 so Data Governance is understood in context.

pathways.name: Business & Product Leaders
pathways.tagline: Lead AI adoption: spot use-cases, design workflows, and prove ROI.
pathways.focus: AI product & transformation leadership: use-case discovery, no-code workflow design, baseline evaluation, deep economics, vendor selection, and agent product logic.

capstone.title: Scope an AI use-case, build a no-code workflow, and define its KPIs/ROI

pathways.name: Technical Builders
pathways.tagline: Build the full stack: eval harnesses, RAG pipelines, tools, and agents.
pathways.focus: AI engineering & core data (full stack): testing harnesses, vector pipelines, tool protocols (MCP), stateful graphs, and model math.

capstone.title: Ship a small RAG-powered agent with an eval harness + guardrails

pathways.name: Frontline & Knowledge Workers
pathways.tagline: Master everyday AI: sharp prompting, smart tools, and daily automation.
pathways.focus: AI everyday productivity: desktop tool mastery, applied prompting, context constraints, computer-use safety, and daily task automation.

capstone.title: Automate one real task in your daily workflow

pathways.name: Legal, Risk & Governance
pathways.tagline: Govern AI safely: acceptable use, data protection, and agent liability.
pathways.focus: AI safety & guardrails: acceptable use, prompt data-leakage protection, dataset access privileges, shadow-AI mitigation, and autonomous-agent liability.

capstone.title: Draft an AI acceptable-use + risk/guardrail policy for a real workflow
